== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Combat Artists are specialized warriors who master [[Combat Arts]], which involve channeling [[Aether]] to empower their physical strikes or manipulate energy. These techniques are distinct from traditional spellcasting, as both disciplines require intense concentration and resonance with the [[Aether]]; attempting to use them simultaneously can cause a combatant to interfere with their own abilities. While [[Combat Arts]] are not sustained spells, they can be used to enhance weaponry—ranging from swords and shields to heavy firearms—or to conjure blades and defensive fields. Some artists utilize specialized equipment, such as beaded necklaces for field generation or [[Aethertech]] augmentations, to aid their performance. Combat Artists vary significantly in power and role. High-level practitioners can be classified as destroyer-class threats, capable of delivering apocalyptic force or even performing feats associated with [[The Perfected|the Perfected]]. Their combat styles can focus on brute offensive power, such as breaking through armor and mechs, or on sophisticated defense. Despite their superhuman speed and strength, they are limited by physical stamina and the human body beneath their gear. While certain species like the [[Visiri]] or [[Karoshan]] are naturally suited for these arts, others, such as the [[Aethril]], often lack the physical strength required. Combat Artists serve in various capacities, including ship security, arena fighting, disaster relief, and elite boarding units.}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Combat Artist is a specialized role and type of fighter possessed by [[Kyri Prest]]. These experienced individuals are defined by their use of intentional movements during battle. Within the ring, Combat Artists typically avoid facing mages. However, they have also been known to attack [[Varic Vallenar|Varic]] with devastating blows.}}
